note: The public guides in docs/player/. Each generator writes its own entry through tools/player_site.py register(); index.html and every page's header are built from this list. Do not edit by hand. Everything in docs/player/ is public.

guides.title: Where to catch what
guides.label: Region map
guides.description: A map of the region's wild encounter areas: what lives in each, how often by day and night, at what level, and where to find any Pokemon you search for.

guides.title: Starters
guides.label: Starters
guides.description: The eight starters on the starter screen: their stats at each tier, how each line evolves, and how to get the items two of them need.

guides.title: Trainer battles
guides.label: Trainer battles
guides.description: Every trainer fight in the order you meet it: teams in Normal and Challenge, where each trainer stands, and the level cap that holds until each leader falls.

guides.title: Items and money
guides.label: Items and money
guides.description: How money works, and every item you can buy, barter for, sell or craft: where, from whom and for how much.

guides.title: TMs
guides.label: TMs
guides.description: Every TM and when you can have it: the badge that opens each one, its move, type and power, and where to craft, buy or win it.

guides.title: Held items
guides.label: Held items
guides.description: Every item a Pokemon can hold and every way to get it: shops, crafting, dungeon vaults, wild drops and wild Pokemon that carry one.

guides.title: What wild Pokemon drop
guides.label: Drops
guides.description: For every Pokemon you can meet in the wild, what it drops when you defeat it and how often; and for every dropped item, which Pokemon to look for.

guides.title: Fishing
guides.label: Fishing
guides.description: What you can catch with a rod in every area and sea, how often it bites, and at what levels.

guides.title: Nuzlocke tracker
guides.label: Nuzlocke
guides.description: Every catch zone in the order you meet it, with a tracker for your Nuzlocke: caught, failed or skipped, the species and nickname, the dupes clause and the level cap.

guides.title: Dungeons
guides.label: Dungeons
guides.description: How rift runs work (sigils, the clock, points, deaths, relics and the optional rooms) and, for each dungeon, its clock at every band, its vault, its ore, what you can catch and the chance of its hidden prize.
